title: The Owner renames, notes, archives and restores a flow from its card, on the Mac or on flowweb.app
description: Daniel (2026-11-11) asked for Add, Edit, Delete and other admin controls for flows in the console. Every shipped flow is code (flows/<key> plus an engine), so this row covers what the Supervisor settings can hold without new engines. A flow can be renamed and given a note, and it can be archived (hidden from the Flows page and turned off; that is how a shipped flow is removed) or restored (back, still off). fwd stores name, note and archived in the Supervisor settings and serves them on GET /v1/supervisor with default_name. New routes are POST /v1/supervisor/flows/{key}/edit {name?, note?}, /archive and /restore, and an archived flow cannot be turned on (409). The site queues flow.edit, flow.archive and flow.restore through hosted/server/requests.mjs, and migration 0011 allows those kinds. Kevin (FW-C-112's console) proposes the same paths. Adding a new flow or duplicating one needs engines that run more than one instance, which is a later row.
acceptance: POST .../edit renames and notes a flow; null or '' clears; bad input 400; unknown flow 404; no session 401
GET /v1/supervisor shows name, default_name, note and archived per flow
Archive turns the flow off and hides it; enabling an archived flow answers 409; restore brings it back off
The site queues flow.edit, flow.archive and flow.restore and the relay maps each to the same route and body
Migration 0011 allows the three kinds and every earlier kind
Each card has Edit (name, note, Save, Archive with a confirm); archived flows list under Archived flows with Restore
